title: Transactions

empty.none: No Transactions yet. They appear once a Statement import's rows are Accepted.

closedNote: {{month}} is closed: amounts and descriptions are locked. Categories can still change, but not to Uncategorised.

reverse.title: Reverse "{{description}}", {{amount}} on {{date}}?
reverse.body: A reversal with the opposite amount is recorded on the same date; both stay in the list.
reverse.bodyImported: Its Imported transaction goes back to To review, to be Accepted again or Discarded.
reverse.backToReview: Its Imported transaction is back in To review.

warning.bankLeg: Its row goes back to To review. If {{counterpart}}'s side was recorded by this Accept, it's reversed too. If you noted it by hand, it stays, In transit.
warning.cashLeg: Only this side is reversed. {{counterpart}}'s side stays Accepted, In transit.
warning.both: Both sides are reversed: this one and {{counterpart}}'s.

reverse.monthClosed: {{account}}'s {{month}} is closed. Reopen it to reverse this.

record.title: Record a Transaction
record.description: Cash paid or received from {{account}}, in {{currency}}.
record.amountHelp: Use a minus for money out, e.g. {{example}}
record.inTransitNote: This stays In transit until {{account}}'s statement row is Accepted as this Transfer.
record.counterpartNotStarted: {{account}} starts on {{date}}: pick that date or later, or another Account
record.clearedExpense: {{category}} was cleared: Expense Categories are for money out.
record.clearedIncome: {{category}} was cleared: Income Categories are for money in.
record.dateBeforeStart: The date can't be before the Account's start date, {{date}}
record.dateInClosedMonth: The months before {{month}} are closed: pick {{date}} or later
record.dateTooLate: The date can't be later than today
record.descriptionTooLong: A description has at most 500 characters
record.payeeHelp: Who was paid, or who paid.
record.payeeTooLong: A payee has at most 200 characters
